senses.gloss: c. (dial. for דשתנא, reduplic. of דָּשְׁנָא) gift, portion.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 156b:5">Sabb. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא שקלת די׳ דיהבו לי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, ed. <he>שקלתי ריסתנאי דיהבת</he>) I took the portion which was given to me (the bride) and gave it &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 42a">Ber. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>שדא</he> … <he>ד׳</he> Ms. M. (read <cite ref="U00284"><he>שדר</he></cite>; ed. <he>שדרו להו ר׳ מבי וכ׳</he>) the Resh Galutha sent them an honorary portion.

<cite ref="Gittin 67b:21">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דחנקא חמותא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ר׳ … חמתא</he>) a gift which chokes a mother-in-law (a colloquial expression for a treacherous gift, as from a diseased animal &c.; differ. in Rashi).
<cite ref="Berakhot 50b:10">Ber. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>שקל</he> … <he>פתק</he> … <he>ד׳</he> Mar Z. took (some of the fruits) and threw them to R. … as his portion of honor (Ms. M. <he>זרק … רומנא</he>).
